sql: SELECT 'status_leads_30d' AS item, string_agg(s || ':' || n, ' ' ORDER BY n DESC) AS valores FROM (SELECT status AS s, count(*) AS n FROM campaign_leads WHERE company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1) a UNION ALL SELECT 'unidade_leads_30d', string_agg(coalesce(u, '-') || ':' || n, ' ' ORDER BY n DESC) FROM (SELECT unit AS u, count(*) AS n FROM campaign_leads WHERE company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1) b UNION ALL SELECT 'visitas_30d_por_status', string_agg(s || ':' || n, ' ' ORDER BY n DESC) FROM (SELECT status_visita AS s, count(*) AS n FROM lead_visits WHERE company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND data_visita >= (now() - interval '30 days')::date AND data_visita <= now()::date GROUP BY 1) c UNION ALL SELECT 'visitas_tipo_30d', string_agg(t || ':' || n, ' ') FROM (SELECT visit_type AS t, count(*) AS n FROM lead_visits WHERE company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND data_visita >= (now() - interval '30 days')::date GROUP BY 1) d UNION ALL SELECT 'festas_criadas_30d', count(*)::text || ' | soma R$ ' || coalesce(sum(total_value), 0)::text FROM company_events WHERE company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' UNION ALL SELECT 'fechados_status_30d_por_updated', count(*)::text FROM campaign_leads WHERE company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND status = 'fechado' AND updated_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
